text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It's almost time for training, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
My body's in good shape.
Feels like I can handle a heavier load than usual...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Damn it, I'm losing my focus.
Maybe I should go get some fresh air to clear my head...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Phew, the breeze really is nice here.
It's quiet, plenty of sunshine...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...My mood's ruined. I'm going to sleep.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swept away by the tranquil atmosphere,
I ended up skipping training altogether.
